title: Borrowed-Face Scout
text: Borrowed-Face Scout wears an unfinished copy of the nearest face and studies which memories make it flinch. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It smiles only after you do.

defeatReward.text: Borrowed-Face Scout is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
